answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A cedar nonce is issued at that moment so the reply cannot be pre-baked. The live answer is compared against the stored wander derivation. A island streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 2848 identities takes 150728 tokens, 40 operator hours and 60 days of exposure.
